Needs changes before merge.

The guide covers the requested features and states the DXF and plasma recipe limits clearly. The three requested file compatibility barriers are present.

Local verification used a clean trial merge with upstream/main at 211105042b817a5b32fdf2c971d42e6d968297c6.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. It selects no Rust suites for these 14 documentation and Python files.
- `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_refresh.py -v`: PASS, 12 tests.
- Zola 0.23.6 `zola build`: PASS, 48 pages, 10 sections, no orphan pages.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: PASS.
- Rust crate builds and clippy do not apply. No Rust crate changed. No GUI test ran.

Extra suites run:

- Full `site/tests` discovery with `ZOLA` set: 77 tests ran. It reports 15 failed subtests and six error subtests.
- The six errors require `node`, which is absent here. Fourteen failed subtests also fail with upstream main's guide content. They concern old tool-label checks and an old AI transport assertion.
- `test_guide_icons.py`: two tests pass; `test_operation_sections_and_guide_components_match_app` fails for PlasmaProfile. This failure is new in this PR. The same assertion passes with upstream main's page.
- No fixture or importer files changed. The extra kernel and importer suites do not apply.

Mutation checks: I restored each of the 12 changed guide pages to upstream main's content in temporary copies. Every mutation makes the coverage suite fail. Restoring each PR page makes all 12 tests pass again. No PR files changed during these checks.

Safety tier: not applicable. This PR changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision checks or stock simulation. No goldens moved. No crates/ui files changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge:

1. `site/content/guide/operations/operations-plasma.md:41`: Keep the operation icon and schematic immediately after `## Plasma Profile`. The new recipe section precedes them and breaks the existing icon assertion. Move the recipe text below the icon, or give it a separate section that preserves the operation heading contract. Run `test_guide_icons.py` again.

   Failure text:
   ```text
   AssertionError: False is not true : operations-plasma.md ## Plasma Profile must start with {{ <icon name="op-plasma-profile" /> }}
   ```

2. `site/content/guide/reference/troubleshooting.md:468`: Remove the claim that AI Chat supports LM Studio. Every local panel preset maps to Ollama in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/transport_http.rs:27`. The panel has no endpoint field. A user who starts LM Studio cannot connect through these controls. State the panel limit and link to the existing `guide/automate/ai.md` page. That page already explains other runtimes and the external-agent route. Replace the pending #1949 pointer at line 476 with that guide link.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Moved the Plasma Profile icon and schematic directly below the operation heading. `test_plasma_profile_starts_with_icon_and_schematic` pins this order. The existing operation icon assertion and rendered-icon test pass.
2. Removed the LM Studio support claim. The text states that all local panel presets use Ollama and have no endpoint field. Both pointers now link to the AI guide. `test_ai_chat_connection_names_panel_limits_and_guide` pins these facts.

Both new tests fail with the original page content and pass with the fixes restored. The guide refresh suite passes all 14 tests. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` and `git diff --check` pass. No Rust crate changed, so clippy does not apply.

The full icon suite still fails because `site/static/icons/act-report.png` is missing. This file is also absent on the original PR head. The requested Plasma Profile assertion passes.

New head: bb8830315bdaef8325511ad98491997905cd3865.

Please re-review these fixes.

<!-- pr-reviewer: bb8830315bdaef8325511ad98491997905cd3865 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Both findings from the earlier review are fixed:

- The Plasma Profile icon and schematic follow the operation heading. The existing icon assertions pass.
- The AI Chat text states that all local panel presets use Ollama and have no endpoint field. Both pointers link to the AI guide. This agrees with `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/transport_http.rs:27`.

The guide covers the requested features and the three file compatibility barriers. It states the DXF generation and stored plasma recipe limits.

Local verification used a clean trial merge with upstream/main at c310c4f615f6069967a83c82a6d79b47600d29d5.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS; 14 changed files, no Rust suites selected.
- `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_refresh.py -v`: PASS; 14 tests.
- Zola 0.23.6 `zola build`: PASS; 48 pages, 10 sections, no orphan pages.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: PASS.
- No Rust crate changed. Rust crate builds and clippy do not apply. No GUI test ran.

Extra suites run:

- `ZOLA=/tmp/zola python3 -B -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_icons.py -v`: PASS; three tests, including the rendered icons.
- Full `site/tests` discovery: 79 tests ran; 19 failed subtests, no errors. These failures concern old tool-label checks and an old AI transport assertion.
- I repeated the existing 65 tests with upstream/main text substituted for the changed guide pages. The same 19 subtests fail. The PR adds no failure.
- No test fixtures or importer code changed. The extra kernel and importer suites do not apply.

Mutation checks: I substituted the original PR text for each fixed page in memory. `test_plasma_profile_starts_with_icon_and_schematic` fails with the old plasma page. `test_ai_chat_connection_names_panel_limits_and_guide` fails with the old troubleshooting page. Each test passes with the fixed text restored. No tracked files changed during these checks.

Safety tier: not applicable. No posted G-code, geometry, gouge checks, collision checks or stock simulation changed. No goldens moved. No crates/ui files changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
